brief.title: Validate Modal sandbox isolation, holdout-safe QLoRA traces and GPU VRAM fit
brief.plain_summary: Check isolated container sandbox flags, filter QLoRA training traces for PII and benchmark holdout overlap, and compute 4-bit NF4 peak VRAM before any GPU run.
brief.outcome: Deterministic pre-flight receipt confirming sandbox safety, holdout separation and GPU VRAM margin.
